O.outcome_detail: honors grades in the online long case examination

cells.quote: 78% of students who attended 10–12 tutorials achieved an honors grade, whereas only 34% of those who attended 0–3 tutorials were awarded honors.
cells.note: Attendance was measured during the six-week program and examination performance was assessed subsequently.

D.treatment: Group 1 students with 2 weeks of prior clinical attachments
D.comparison: Groups 2 and 3 students with 5 or 7 weeks of prior clinical attachments

O.outcome_detail: grade distribution in the online long case examination

cells.quote: Interestingly, grade distribution was similar across groups 1,2 and 3, despite the differing levels of clinical experience prior to the online program commencing (Fig. 2, panels A and B) (p = 0.48).
cells.note: The groups were pre-existing rotation groups with different amounts of clinical experience; the non-significant result is coded ns rather than equivalence.
